description: This file defines the OA_Dll_Zone class, which extends a base DLL class to manage zone data, validation, permissions, linking/unlinking banners and campaigns, and generating ad tags within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Dll_Zone
classes.description: A class extending OA_Dll to manage ad zones, including data setting, validation, permission checks, linking/unlinking banners and campaigns, and generating ad tags.

methods.name: _setZoneDataFromArray
methods.description: Populates an OA_Dll_ZoneInfo object with data from an array, mapping fields and extracting chained zone ID.

methods.name: _validateZoneType
methods.description: Validates that the zone type is within the allowed set (0-4).

methods.name: _validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of a zone object, including type, structure, existence, and logical constraints.

methods.name: _validateForStatistics
methods.description: Validates zone ID and date order for statistics queries.

methods.name: checkStatisticsPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permissions to view statistics for a zone.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Creates or updates a zone record, handling permissions, validation, and database operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a zone record after permission and existence checks.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves zone data and populates an OA_Dll_ZoneInfo object.

methods.name: getZoneListByPublisherId
methods.description: Fetches all zones associated with a publisher.

methods.name: getZoneDailyStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves daily statistics for a zone over a specified period.

methods.name: getZoneHourlyStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves hourly statistics for a zone over a specified period.

methods.name: getZoneAdvertiserStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves advertiser-specific statistics for a zone.

methods.name: getZoneCampaignStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves campaign-specific statistics for a zone.

methods.name: getZoneBannerStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves banner-specific statistics for a zone.

methods.name: linkBanner
methods.description: Links a banner to a zone if permissions and existence checks pass.

methods.name: linkCampaign
methods.description: Links a campaign to a zone if permissions and existence checks pass.

methods.name: unlinkBanner
methods.description: Unlinks a banner from a zone.

methods.name: unlinkCampaign
methods.description: Unlinks a campaign from a zone.

methods.name: generateTags
methods.description: Generates ad invocation tags for a zone based on code type and parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedTags
methods.description: Returns a list of allowed invocation tag types.
